course.title: Applied Statistics and Queuing Theory
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: After giving a bad class test, Pranto is requesting the assigned faculty of statistics from CSÉ (10) dept. for some extra points. Instead of providing free points, the faculty suggests a game where Pranto will toss two coins into the air simultaneously and will earn one point for each number of heads. However, he will lose five points if either of the coins fails to produce a single head. Calculate the expected value of the proposed game and determine whether or not Pranto should play the game?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
